tldr: AI 需求續撐台灣半導體鏈，外資與政策資金同步進場，台積電財報前多頭氣盛。
壽險上半年稅前盈餘約 3,094 億元寫同期新高，但 6、7 月股債齊跌使動能降溫。
七月為台股 ETF 除息旺季，逾 90 檔配息，高股息與市值型仍是定期定額主力。
週五美股收高、7 月收紅，道瓊連四月上漲，亞馬遜受惠 AWS 財報大好而勁揚。
聯準會分歧決議維持利率 3.50%-3.75%，油價受中東緊張推升、逼近 85 美元創 3 月來最強單月。

items.title_zh: 外資、政策資金同步進場，AI 成唯一主戰場
items.title_en: Foreign and policy funds pile into AI as the sole battleground
items.summary_zh: 台股維持歷史高檔震盪，AI 題材同時吸引外資與政策相關資金進駐，資金由 GPU、AI 伺服器擴散至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB/CCL、電源與 HBM/CoWoS，半導體鏈續居盤面主流，財報行情前多頭氣勢明顯。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's equity market has stayed firm around record highs, with the AI theme drawing both foreign investors and domestic policy-linked capital. Money is rotating from GPUs and AI servers into rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply and HBM/CoWoS names, keeping the semiconductor chain as the market's clear leadership ahead of key earnings.

items.title_zh: 台積電財報前，半導體鏈全線飆漲
items.title_en: Chip supply chain rallies broadly ahead of TSMC results
items.summary_zh: AI 需求強勁，台積電財報公布前台灣半導體供應鏈全面走揚，晶圓代工、IC 設計、載板與散熱同步上攻。漲勢廣度顯示推動這波行情的是 AI 算力的終端需求，而非單一個股，族群輪動仍具續航力。
items.summary_en: Strong AI-driven demand lifted the entire Taiwan semiconductor supply chain in the run-up to TSMC's earnings, with foundry, IC design, substrate and cooling suppliers advancing together. The breadth of the move underlines that end demand for AI compute, rather than a single stock, is powering the current leg of the rally.

items.title_zh: 全球半導體 2026 年估達 7,607 億美元創高
items.title_en: Global chip market seen hitting a record US$760.7bn in 2026
items.summary_zh: 法人預估 2026 年全球半導體市場規模約 7,607 億美元、年增 8.5%，改寫歷史新高，動能來自 AI 帶動的設備到晶片製造全鏈擴張。此一展望凸顯台灣在先進封裝與晶圓代工的關鍵地位，隨 AI 算力需求擴散而受惠。
items.summary_en: Industry forecasts put the 2026 global semiconductor market at about US$760.7 billion, up 8.5% year on year and a fresh record, driven by AI across the value chain from equipment to chipmaking. The outlook reinforces Taiwan's central role in advanced packaging and foundry as AI compute demand broadens.

items.title_zh: 台積電 CoWoS 產能擴四倍、6 月營收大增
items.title_en: TSMC quadruples CoWoS capacity as June revenue jumps
items.summary_zh: 台積電 6 月合併營收約 4,426.8 億元，月增 6.2%、年增 67.9%，打破近四年 6 月營收下滑的季節性。公司正把 CoWoS 先進封裝產能自 2024 年底每月約 3.5 萬片，拉升至 2026 年底每月 12～14 萬片，成長四倍以因應 AI 需求。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported June consolidated revenue of about NT$442.68bn, up 6.2% on the month and 67.9% on the year, breaking a four-year seasonal decline. The company is expanding CoWoS advanced-packaging output from roughly 35,000 wafers a month in late 2024 toward 120,000-140,000 by end-2026, a fourfold rise to meet AI demand.

items.title_zh: 金管會揭保險監理三方向
items.title_en: FSC sets three supervisory priorities for insurers
items.summary_zh: 金管會指出，保險業今年接軌 IFRS 17，未來監理聚焦三面向：推動 AI 科技轉型、引導綠色金融投資，以及建構全齡金融體系並擴大微型保險，以因應超高齡社會與氣候變遷。此監理框架將牽動壽險資金運用與商品設計方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission outlined three directions for insurance oversight as the industry adopts IFRS 17 this year: promoting AI-driven transformation, guiding green-finance investment, and building an all-ages financial system with expanded micro-insurance. The framework responds to a super-aged society and climate risk, shaping how insurers deploy capital and design products.

items.title_zh: 保險業上半年獲利創高、動能降溫
items.title_en: Insurers post record first-half profit but momentum cools
items.summary_zh: 據金管會統計，產壽險上半年稅前盈餘約 3,094 億元，寫下史上同期新高。不過壽險 6 月獲利連兩月下滑，7 月又逢股債齊跌承壓，顯示最甜蜜時刻可能已過，下半年獲利波動值得留意。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life and non-life insurers booked pre-tax profit of about NT$309.4bn in the first half, a record for the period, according to FSC data. However, life-insurance earnings fell for a second straight month in June and faced further pressure in July as stocks and bonds declined together, signalling the sweet spot may be passing.

items.title_zh: 七月台股 ETF 進入配息旺季
items.title_en: July marks peak ETF ex-dividend season in Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 七月逾 90 檔台股 ETF 除息，為全年最大配息潮，涵蓋高股息、市值型、主題與主動式基金；其中 00961 以約 18% 年化配息率居冠。顯示在指數高檔之際，收益型 ETF 對追求現金流的投資人仍具吸引力，惟需留意填息與價差風險。
items.summary_en: More than 90 Taiwan-listed ETFs distributed dividends in July, the year's busiest payout window, spanning high-yield, market-cap, thematic and active funds. Fund 00961 topped the yield rankings around 18% annualised, underscoring income ETFs' continued pull for yield-seeking investors even as valuations sit near highs.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.summary_zh: 2026 年 0050、00919、00878 等市值型與高股息 ETF 仍是散戶定期定額的核心標的，主動式 ETF 亦首度擠進排行。此配置顯示市值型作為基底、股息型提供穩定現金流，可作為長期累積資產的參考策略，惟仍須注意景氣與市場波動。
items.summary_en: Market-cap and high-dividend ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 remain the core of Taiwan retail investors' regular fixed-amount ("dollar-cost") plans in 2026, with active ETFs newly breaking into the top rankings. The mix shows market-cap funds as the base allocation and dividend funds for steady income, guiding long-term accumulation strategies.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 房地合一稅 2.0 短期重稅結構不變
items.title_en: Property gains tax 2.0 keeps steep short-holding rates
items.summary_zh: 依現行房地合一稅 2.0，個人持有房地 2 年以內出售，稅率 45%；逾 2 年未逾 5 年為 35%；逾 5 年降至 20%、逾 10 年 15%。此累進級距持續抑制短期炒作，也牽動家庭出售不動產的時點規劃，交易前宜先試算稅負與持有期間。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's House and Land Transactions Income Tax 2.0, gains on property held two years or less are taxed at 45%, and 35% for holdings over two to five years, before stepping down to 20% beyond five years and 15% after ten. The tiered structure continues to penalise short-term flipping and shapes how households time property sales.

items.title_zh: 大陸地區來源所得須併入綜所稅申報
items.title_en: Mainland-source income must be filed with Taiwan income tax
items.summary_zh: 財政部提醒，個人取得大陸地區來源所得，應併入臺灣地區來源所得辦理綜合所得稅結算申報，於當地已納稅額可於限額內扣抵。此規定攸關兩岸工作與投資族群，若漏報恐面臨補稅與罰鍰，報稅時應留意所得歸戶與憑證留存。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reminds individuals that income derived from mainland China must be consolidated with Taiwan-source income when filing consolidated income tax, with tax already paid there creditable within limits. The rule matters for residents and cross-strait workers, and overlooking it can trigger back taxes and penalties.

items.title_zh: 央行：經濟穩健成長、通膨溫和
items.title_en: Central bank sees steady growth with contained inflation
items.summary_zh: 央行預估台灣經濟續呈穩健成長，通膨維持溫和，CPI 年增率約 2%。惟提醒基期偏高與全球貿易量成長放緩，將使出口與民間投資動能趨緩，民間消費則可望增溫。整體政策環境大致平衡，後續仍須觀察國際景氣與資金情勢對利率路徑的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank projects the economy will keep expanding at a solid pace with inflation staying moderate, with CPI running around 2%. It cautions that a high comparison base and a forecast slowdown in global trade volume will temper export and private-investment momentum, while private consumption is expected to pick up, framing a broadly balanced policy backdrop.

items.title_zh: AI 與 HPC 需求撐起台灣出口與投資
items.title_en: AI and HPC demand underpin Taiwan's export and investment
items.summary_zh: 研究機構指出，AI、高效能運算（HPC）及半導體先進製程需求強勁，持續帶動台灣出口與企業資本支出。科技主導的動能雖支撐成長，卻也使經濟高度集中於高階電子，一旦全球 AI 投資循環反轉，出口與投資將較易受衝擊，結構分散仍是中長期課題。
items.summary_en: Research institutes note that robust demand for AI, high-performance computing and advanced semiconductor processes continues to drive Taiwan's exports and corporate capital spending. The tech-led momentum supports growth but concentrates the economy's fortunes on a narrow band of high-end electronics, leaving it exposed to any swing in the global AI investment cycle.

items.title_zh: Fed 維持利率 3.50%-3.75%、決議分歧
items.title_en: Fed holds rates at 3.50%-3.75% in a divided vote
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會 7 月會議維持政策利率於 3.50%-3.75%，9 票贊成、3 票主張升息 1 碼。官員示警通膨風險，主因能源價格走高，5 月核心 PCE 升至 3.4%；市場預期年底前仍有 1 至 2 次升息空間。政策偏鷹，對全球資金成本與風險性資產評價形成壓力。
items.summary_en: At its July meeting the Federal Reserve left its policy rate at 3.50%-3.75%, with nine members in favour and three dissenting for a quarter-point hike. Officials flagged inflation risk driven largely by higher energy prices, with core PCE accelerating to 3.4% in May, and investors now see one to two hikes possible by year-end.

items.title_zh: OPEC+ 8 月起增產每日 54.8 萬桶
items.title_en: OPEC+ lifts output by 548,000 bpd from August
items.summary_zh: OPEC+ 同意自 8 月 1 日起增產每日 54.8 萬桶，高於市場預期約 41.1 萬桶，延續逐步回補為期兩年、約每日 220 萬桶減產的計畫，預計 9 月前完成。增幅超出預期之際，中東航運緊張仍為油價維持風險溢價，供給與地緣兩股力量拉鋸將主導後市油價。
items.summary_en: OPEC+ agreed to raise crude production by 548,000 barrels a day from 1 August, above the roughly 411,000 expected, continuing to unwind a two-year output cut of about 2.2 million bpd by September. The larger-than-expected increase comes as Middle East shipping tensions keep a risk premium in the oil price.

items.title_zh: 美股週五收高，道瓊連四月收紅（2026-07-31，最近交易日）
items.title_en: US stocks close higher Friday; Dow logs fourth straight winning month (2026-07-31，最近交易日)
items.summary_zh: 美股 7 月最後一個交易日走高，投資人淡化債券殖利率上揚，亞馬遜大漲。標普 500 漲 0.7% 收 7,489.72，那斯達克漲 1% 收 25,373.85，道瓊漲 276.97 點、0.53% 收 52,485.03，寫下連續第四個月收紅，由亞馬遜、Alphabet、輝達領軍。
items.summary_en: Wall Street rose on the final session of July, shrugging off higher bond yields as Amazon jumped. The S&P 500 added 0.7% to 7,489.72, the Nasdaq gained 1% to 25,373.85 and the Dow rose 276.97 points, or 0.53%, to 52,485.03, capping its fourth straight winning month, led by Amazon, Alphabet and Nvidia.

items.title_zh: 亞馬遜第二季營收破 2,000 億美元、AWS 增速達 37%（2026-07-31）
items.title_en: Amazon Q2 revenue tops $200bn as AWS growth hits 37% (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 亞馬遜第二季營收約 2,006 億美元、每股盈餘 5.75 美元，優於預期；雲端 AWS 營收年增 37% 至 422 億美元，為 18 季來最快。公司將 2026 年資本支出計畫上調至約 2,200 億美元，多用於 AI，股價盤後大漲約 15%，顯示雲端與 AI 需求強勁。
items.summary_en: Amazon reported second-quarter revenue of about $200.6bn and EPS of $5.75, beating estimates, with AWS revenue up 37% to $42.2bn, its fastest growth in 18 quarters. The company lifted 2026 capex plans toward $220bn, largely for AI, and shares surged around 15%.

items.title_zh: 蘋果財報後股價下跌約 7%（2026-07-31）
items.title_en: Apple shares drop about 7% after earnings (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 蘋果公布季度財報後，股價下跌約 7%，與同日亞馬遜的大漲形成強烈對比。兩者迥異的市場反應凸顯投資人正大幅獎勵雲端與 AI 動能，同時對被視為 AI 變現進度落後的公司給予懲罰，科技巨頭之間的分化態勢日益明顯。
items.summary_en: Apple stock fell roughly 7% following its quarterly results, a stark contrast to Amazon's surge on the same day. The divergent reactions underscored how sharply investors are rewarding cloud and AI momentum while punishing companies seen as lagging on the AI monetisation curve.

items.title_zh: 原油創 3 月來最強單月、逼近每桶 85 美元（2026-07-31）
items.title_en: Crude caps its best month since March near $85 (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 美國原油週五上漲約 1% 至每桶約 85 美元，7 月累計漲幅逾 20%，為 3 月以來最強單月表現。中東緊張升溫，包括荷莫茲海峽附近油輪傳遭攻擊，加上供應航線疑慮推升油價；即便 OPEC+ 準備增產，地緣風險溢價仍主導盤面，通膨與運輸成本壓力值得關注。
items.summary_en: US crude rose about 1% on Friday to around $85 a barrel, capping a July gain of more than 20%, its strongest monthly rise since March. Escalating Middle East tensions, including reported attacks on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz, and concerns over supply routes drove the rally even as OPEC+ prepared to raise output.
